summary: Accepted after independent re-review. The hardened release benchmark now proves exact 1,000-item completion on both Defer and Relay through per-batch cardinality and actual completion counters, uses an asserted exactly 128-byte serialized JSON payload for both sides and disk amplification, fails closed on every required missing/zero/non-finite metric, and hard-enforces the independent Relay ratio ceiling at 0.80. A parsed machine-readable benchmark contract and matching emitted scope fields constrain the evidence to a same-host sibling implementation comparison with process-shared RSS, a non-authoritative dated observation, no Cloud Tasks performance result, and no universal superiority claim.
